summary: Practise team leadership, coaching, conflict response and decision accountability. Review the five-day course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Project leadership helps project managers, coordinators and team leads clarify accountability and keep delivery decisions moving across teams. You will assess authority and team dynamics, adapt direction and support to project situations, coach with GROW, choose conflict responses, and build RACI decision maps, team working agreements and action plans that support follow-through.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who coordinate project work or guide people who report through different functions. It is designed for people who need practical ways to clarify responsibility, coach delivery teams and keep project decisions moving.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project teams, project plans and stakeholder roles. No coding or specialist software is required.
